name: memory-automation-lifecycle
observations: [2026-10-25] READ: .kiro/hooks/memory-first-read.json (SessionStart, agent) + .kiro/steering/memory-first.md (always-included) — consult graph before non-trivial tasks; skip trivial one-offs.
[2026-10-25] WRITE: .kiro/hooks/session-retrospective.json (Stop, agent) — reflects on session; delegates to memory-updater only if durable fact produced; silent otherwise.
[2026-10-25] Retrieval: never call read_graph; search_nodes + batched open_nodes with short single keywords. See .kiro/steering/delegation-and-workflow.md 'Memory discipline'.
[2026-10-25] Only memory-updater writes to graph; retrospective hook cannot commit/push (enforced by git-safety rule; hooks are read-only on filesystem).

[2026-10-25] SessionStart hook mandatorily calls open_nodes(["user-preferences"]) every session regardless of task triviality. Documented in .kiro/steering/memory-first.md §"Always load user preferences first".

[2026-10-27] CORRECTION: Claude Code SessionStart/Setup hooks support ONLY command and mcp_tool types — NOT prompt/http/agent. A prompt-type SessionStart is silently ignored. (verified vs code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks)

[2026-10-27] Claude Code Stop hook remains type prompt (Stop DOES support prompt hooks — was correct). .claude/hooks/hooks.json also holds slides-ai-plugin PostToolUse+Stop hooks; memory entries merged in, not overwritten. Kiro hooks (.kiro/hooks/*.json) unaffected.
[2026-10-27] SUPERSEDES prev: SessionStart hook cmd (hooks.json): python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/scripts/memory_first.py" || python "...same path".
[2026-10-27] WHY python3||python fallback: macOS (Santhan) has python3 not python; Windows has python not python3. Fallback covers both platforms.
[2026-10-27] MECHANISM: Claude Code cmd hooks run via shell (sh -c on macOS/Linux, Git Bash/PS on Windows) so || and $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR expand. (verified code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks)
[2026-10-27] CAVEAT: Windows without Git Bash → PowerShell fallback; $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR won't expand, || not POSIX — hook breaks. Git Bash ships with Git (CONTRIBUTING.md req), so unlikely.

[2026-10-27] CONFIG PORTABILITY: .kiro/settings/mcp.json and .claude/mcp.json hardcode MEMORY_FILE_PATH to absolute Windows path; other machines read empty graph. Per-machine edit required. See CONTRIBUTING.md §Memory Hooks Setup.

[2026-10-27] NO PORTABLE FIX: omitting MEMORY_FILE_PATH defaults to npx-cache dir (not repo). ${workspaceFolder} is VS-Code-only; ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} not substituted in .mcp.json env blocks (issue #69123). Manual edit is correct approach.

[2026-10-27] CONTRIBUTING.md §Memory Hooks Setup added (unstaged): prerequisites (Node/npx, python3, Git Bash on Windows, per-machine MEMORY_FILE_PATH edit, Kiro MCP permission) + verification via open_nodes(["user-preferences"]) in fresh session.

[2026-10-27] COMMIT: memory-hooks work on branch feature/subhash as 2142366 (8 files: Kiro+Claude hooks, memory-first.md, memory_first.py, .kiro/settings/mcp.json, CONTRIBUTING.md, knowledge-graph JSONL). Not pushed.
